name: Sigil of Ignaeus
summary: The Sigil of Ignaeus is formed from four ancient sigils in Hammerfall. Its light can break the wardings on Trollbane's tomb.

sections.title: The Joined Sigils
sections.body: In Hammerfall, Zengu gives you the Sigil of Ignaeus after the four separate sigils are brought together. Its glowing lines match the etchings on the face of Trollbane's tomb in the Sanctum at Stromgarde. The tomb's wardings bar the way to what lies within.

sections.title: At Trollbane's Tomb
sections.body: When you match the sigil's lines to the etchings on Trollbane's tomb, a flash of light consumes it. The stone hands release the legendary sword Trol'kalar.

faq.q: What is the Sigil of Ignaeus?
faq.answer: The Sigil of Ignaeus is a single sigil formed when the Sigils of Strom, Thoradin, Arathor, and Trollbane are brought together.

faq.q: Who gives you the Sigil of Ignaeus?
faq.answer: Zengu gives you the Sigil of Ignaeus in Hammerfall.
Its glowing lines match the etchings on Trollbane's tomb and break the wardings that guard it.
Trollbane's tomb lies in the Sanctum behind the chapel in Stromgarde.

faq.q: What happens to the sigil at the tomb?
faq.answer: A flash of light consumes the Sigil of Ignaeus when its lines are matched to the tomb's etchings.
